item.title: Version 1.8.0
item.description:
ScoreSort 1.8.0

✨ General

  • Many more keyboard shortcuts! ⌘O/⌘S/⇧⌘P/⌘⌫/⌘R now do what you might expect them to. In the combiner, ⇧⌘P pushes you out to Preview, ready to print with ⌘P. You can also always open the folder you're working in with ⇧⌘F. See the Help menu for a full Keyboard Shortcuts reference.
  • Redesigned menu bar — proper File / View / per-tab Actions menus now cover much more of the app's functionality.
  • Many more significant but invisible changes under the hood.

✂️ Split

  • Jazz naming suggestions overhauled.
  • Return / Escape to move between steps with the keyboard.
  • It's now easier to promote unmatched files in Step 3 using the arrow keys.

🔗 Combine

  • Preset sidebar now live-syncs with Preferences.
  • Much smarter preset matching between the side panel and the files you've dragged in (abbreviations/aliases are now understood, clef-precise euphonium, "Clarinet" ≠ "Bass Clarinet").
  • Collate groups get their own colour, distinct from your selection colour.

item.title: Version 1.7.0
item.description:
ScoreSort 1.7.0

✨ General improvements

  • Drop a new file onto the “Done” screen to start the next job immediately, without clicking Start Over (Rename, Bulk Rename, and Split).

🏷️ Rename Files

  • Batch renaming. Rename multiple folders of pieces at once — drag in a parent folder of nested folders, or several folders together, and the app walks you through them one after another.
  • You can now rename image scans (e.g. JPGs) as well as PDFs.

🔗 Combine PDFs

  • Drag to reorder files. Collate groups move as a unit, and you can drop a file onto a group to add it in.

✂️ Split PDF

  • Undo/redo while splitting. ⌘Z / ⌘⇧Z undo and redo split-point, skip, and re-stride edits in Step 1.
  • Drag to pan the part preview in the naming step (the page strip or its minimap), not just the arrow buttons.
  • Much smarter instrument-name suggestions, now driven by the selected ensemble (Wind Band / Jazz Band / Orchestra): suggestions follow that ensemble’s real score order (e.g. Horn follows Trumpet in a band), use ensemble-aware part counts, prefer full instrument names, and handle the clarinet family and baritone/euphonium better.
  • Duplicate-name warning when two files would get the same name; saving is blocked if they’d truly collide.
  • General improvements to the score-order prefix screen.

🐞 Fixed

  • Keyboard shortcuts are now strictly limited to the current tab.
  • The part-name preview no longer clips the instrument name at the top of the page.
  • Dragging a new PDF onto the splitter’s “Done” screen no longer leaves a blank Step 1 preview.

item.title: Version 1.6.0
item.description:
ScoreSort 1.6.0

New

  • Splitter — move the original to Trash. A new checkbox on Step 2 cleans up the source PDF after your split files are saved. Off by default, remembered between uses, and recoverable (it goes to the Trash).
  • Splitter — A3 page preview. The "which half comes first?" dialog now shows a preview of your actual page behind the left/right selector.

Improved

  • Easier-to-hit “Clear” buttons in every tool.

Fixed

  • The app no longer quits from the update dialog at launch.
  • No “check for updates automatically?” prompt on the very first launch.

item.title: Version 1.5.2
item.description:
ScoreSort 1.5.2

Reliability fix: automatic updates now install correctly. (Earlier versions couldn't complete an in-app update — please update manually this once, and future updates will be automatic.)

item.title: Version 1.5.1
item.description:
ScoreSort 1.5.1

A small polish update:

  • Expanded the Welcome Tour — clearer guidance for combining (images, blank pages, table of contents) and splitting, including A3 sheet splitting and booklet reordering.
  • Tidied the default window size and minor UI refinements.
